sections.heading: DESCRIPTION
sections.body:
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while the cat watches from
       the window, wondering why anyone would bother jumping over a dog at all
       when there are perfectly good ways around it, as described in frob(1)
       and at https://example.org/frob for more.

       Assume tab stops at each COLS instead of eight
       May also be specified with the TABSIZE environment variable.

       For example:

              frob -a

              {
                  "key": [1, 2],
              }

   Subsection here

sections.heading: OPTIONS
sections.body:
-a, --all
              Do not ignore entries starting with a dot, which are normally
              hidden from view by default here.

       -l     use a long listing format

       --help Show help.

       --color[=WHEN]
              Colorize the output; WHEN can be always, auto or never, and
              defaults to always when given alone.

              A second paragraph of the same description, which should stay
              inside the same definition rather than escape.

                     $ frob --color=never
